prompt:
You are a equity research analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2026-02-19, give a 20-trading-day directional recommendation for the stock.
Valid answers (choose exactly one): BUY, HOLD, SELL.
Company information (as of 2026-02-19):
| Return 3m            | +7.8% |
| Return 1m            | +0.3% |
| Return 1w            | +3.8% |
| Range position (63d) | 86% |
| 21d realized vol     | 19% |
| Last close           | 156.51 |
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The stock has shown positive near-term momentum (3.8% last week, 7.8% over 3 months), but it is currently at about the 86th percentile of its 63-day range, indicating limited upside room and potential near-term mean reversion. With moderate volatility (21d realized vol ~19%), the risk-reward over the next ~20 trading days favors waiting for a clearer breakout or pullback.

DECISION: HOLD
